a.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget has resumed Bitcoin withdrawals suspended after suspected North Korean hackers breached its systems last week and stole over $350 million. [...]
a.title: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals after $387.5 million crypto heist

b.lede: The $351 million theft from crypto exchange Bitget is the latest in a string of high-profile hacks targeting the crypto sector.
b.title: North Korean hackers suspected in $351M crypto theft, the largest so far this year
